header.title: Services Health & Performance Monitoring
header.subtitle: Real-time visibility into your entire technology stack with AI-powered observability

hero.title: Monitor Everything. Everywhere. Always.
hero.description: Comprehensive monitoring and observability platform providing real-time insights into your applications, infrastructure, and user experiences. From synthetic monitoring to real user monitoring (RUM), distributed tracing to infrastructure metrics—we ensure your systems perform optimally 24/7/365.

sections.title: Real User Monitoring (RUM)
sections.description: Capture and analyze real user interactions with your web applications and mobile apps. RUM provides genuine performance data from actual users across different devices, browsers, locations, and network conditions—giving you the complete picture of user experience.
benefits: Track real user page load times and interactions
Identify performance bottlenecks affecting actual users
Analyze user journeys and conversion funnels
Core Web Vitals monitoring (LCP, FID, CLS)

sections.title: Synthetic Monitoring
sections.description: Automated, scripted tests that simulate user interactions from multiple global locations. Synthetic monitoring proactively detects issues before real users are affected, validates SLAs, and ensures your services are available and performing optimally around the clock.
benefits: API endpoint health checks and response time tracking
Multi-step transaction monitoring (login flows, checkout, etc.)

sections.title: Full-Stack Observability
sections.description: Unified observability across your entire technology stack—from frontend user experiences to backend microservices, databases, cloud infrastructure, and networks. We integrate metrics, logs, and traces into a single, coherent view, enabling rapid troubleshooting and optimization.
benefits: Business KPI correlation with technical metrics

sections.title: AI-Powered Anomaly Detection
sections.description: Machine learning algorithms automatically establish performance baselines and detect anomalies in real-time. Our AI reduces alert fatigue by identifying genuine issues, predicting potential failures, and providing root cause analysis—so your team focuses on what matters.
benefits: Intelligent anomaly detection with minimal false positives
Predictive alerts before issues impact users
Correlation of related events across the stack

sections.title: Infrastructure Monitoring
sections.description: Comprehensive monitoring of your infrastructure—from on-premise servers and network devices to cloud instances, containers, and serverless functions. Track resource utilization, capacity planning, and cost optimization across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
benefits: Server CPU, memory, disk, and network monitoring

platforms.title: Powered by Industry-Leading Platforms
platforms.description: We leverage the best observability tools in the industry to deliver comprehensive monitoring solutions

tools.name: Dynatrace
tools.description: AI-powered full-stack observability with automatic instrumentation, distributed tracing, and Davis AI engine for intelligent problem detection.

tools.name: Elastic (ELK Stack)
tools.description: Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, and Beats for log aggregation, search, and visualization at petabyte scale.

tools.name: Grafana
tools.description: Beautiful dashboards, unified logging with Loki, distributed tracing with Tempo, and metrics with Prometheus.

tools.name: Prometheus
tools.description: Open-source monitoring system with dimensional time series database, powerful query language (PromQL), and alerting.
